default_parameters: No faults; owned proxy forwarding enabled.
toxiproxy_mapping: Remove owned toxics and enable owned proxy.
behavior: Clear owned faults and restore forwarding; retain proxy routing.
restoration: Already normal is idempotent; reconnect if an earlier fault terminated or desynchronized the session.
validation_and_limits: Require enabled integration; no global reset or foreign proxy changes.

behavior: Delay TCP data with fixed latency.
restoration: Apply normal; mailbox contents remain unchanged.
validation_and_limits: Require nonnegative integer milliseconds; both uses the delay in each direction. Allow timing tolerances.

behavior: Vary delay around the base latency.
restoration: Apply normal; reconnect if client deadlines have already ended the session.
validation_and_limits: Require 0 <= jitter <= latency; this profile is intentionally nondeterministic and does not define a total command response time.

behavior: Stall traffic and close after the interval.
restoration: Apply normal and reconnect after a closed session.
validation_and_limits: Require a positive interval; a proxy close interval differs from a client timeout. Does not guarantee a connect-handshake timeout.

restoration: Apply normal and reconnect; missing bytes cannot be replayed.
validation_and_limits: Tests must configure finite client deadlines and guaranteed cleanup; not packet loss at the IP layer.

toxiproxy_mapping: Set owned proxy enabled false; not a toxic.
behavior: Disable the listener while proxy mode remains selected; clients see connection failure.
restoration: Apply normal to restore the same proxy endpoint; reconnect.
validation_and_limits: Distinct from network disable which returns to direct routing; GreenMail continues running.

behavior: Cause peer resets; the fault remains selected until replaced.
validation_and_limits: Require nonnegative delay; verify reset visibility for the supported OS and Toxiproxy versions rather than exact exception text.

behavior: Limit throughput per connection and direction.
restoration: Apply normal to remove the cap.
validation_and_limits: Require a positive integer in Toxiproxy KB/s units; not bits/s or a global quota. Use large enough payloads for meaningful checks.
